messages:
Alex (Sales): Passing Acero Health to CS — they signed last week, want to start pilot ASAP.
Alex (Sales): Deal size: 10 seats, expected ~200k tokens/day in pilot. Go-live target: ~30 days. Renewal in ~11 months.
Alex (Sales): Blockers: Okta SSO + SCIM timing, and two prompt families need safety/PII sign-off.
Maria (CS): Thanks — I'll take point. Can you drop the provisioning ticket and the Okta contact?
Alex (Sales): Prov ticket PROV-4128. Okta admin: laura@acero.co, +1-415-555-0123. Contract: https://redwood.example/contracts/ACERO-PLG
Maria (CS): Got it. CS asks: 1) confirm SSO attribute/field mapping, 2) schedule a 60m enablement with their AI/platform team.
Maria (CS): Also need representative prompts for safety/regression checks. Ask for 5 examples with expected outputs.
Tara (CS Manager): Ill scope the enablement sessions. Assigning Priya (Support) for provisioning follow-up and Jamal (Eng) for SCIM/connectors.
Priya (Support): I pulled PROV-4128. Once we have the SAML/IdP metadata and a SCIM service account, test ETA is ~3 business days.
Priya (Support): @Alex please ask them to upload metadata to the ticket and create a temp service account for SCIM with admin privileges.
Jamal (Engineering): SCIM note: our current private deploy has a group->role mapping quirk with Okta. Need to validate schema v2.0. Ill do a 1-day spike.
Jamal (Engineering): If they want OU-based role mapping, estimate ~2 days dev + testing. Will open an ENG follow-up if needed.
Maria (CS): Alex — can you confirm they can share the 5 prompts by EOD tomorrow? They flagged long sequences (up to ~1500 tokens) which could affect latency.
Alex (Sales): I'll nudge them; they said yes to providing examples. Also asked about latency for long chat sessions.
Tara (CS Manager): Note for Optimize: recommend quantization/quality settings for mixed sequence workloads after pilot. Add to post-onboard items.
Maria (CS): Success metrics to track: time-to-first-response, P95 latency, and prompt eval pass rate (target >=95%).
Priya (Support): After metadata upload, Ill run SAML traces in staging and post results to PROV-4128. Add me as watcher.
Alex (Sales): Added Priya and Jamal to ticket watchers, told customer to upload metadata today.
DeployBot: [auto] PROV-4128 updated: watchers=Priya,Jamal,Maria.
Maria (CS): Drafting action list:
- Owners: Maria (CS lead), Tara (onboard ops), Priya (prov/support), Jamal (eng integration)
- Immediate: collect prompts + Okta metadata (owner: Alex)
- 1-3 days: SCIM compatibility spike (owner: Jamal)
- Within 3 business days of metadata: test SSO + SCIM in staging (owner: Priya)
- Within 7 days: enablement session 60m (owner: Tara)
- 30-day post-onboard: cost & performance review (owner: Optimize team)
Maria (CS): Renewal watch: medium risk (pilot small, procurement cost sensitivity). We'll monitor usage and engagement weekly.
Tara (CS Manager): Health tags: onboarding_priority=high, renewal_watch=medium, exec_champion=Laura (customer Okta admin).
Jamal (Engineering): Filing ENG-ACERO-SCIM if they request OU->role mapping. Will reference PROV-4128.
Priya (Support): Timeline: after metadata, I can run staging tests within 24hrs. Please post temp test creds in ticket (DM not email).
Alex (Sales): Shared temp test creds in PROV-4128 DM to Priya. Customer will upload metadata today.
Maria (CS): Scheduling a brief internal kickoff tomorrow 10:30am PT to align owners. Agenda: context, deliverables, risks. Invite sent.
Tara (CS Manager): Add a short safety checklist for prompt review; require engineering sign-off on any redactions.
Maria (CS): Customer requested a feedback channel during pilot. Proposal: shared Slack channel + weekly 30m sync.
Alex (Sales): They prefer Slack — I'll create the shared channel and invite their rep + our team.
Priya (Support): Ops note: monitor auth errors and token issues for first 72 hours after SSO go-live.
Jamal (Engineering): Optional: role-based cache invalidation for SCIM changes could add work. Mark as optional in ENG ticket.
Maria (CS): Summary: Owners assigned, PROV-4128 linked, Okta metadata + prompts due EOD tomorrow, internal kickoff 10:30am PT tomorrow. Will post notes and tasks after call.
Alex (Sales): Thanks team :rocket:
Maria (CS): Thanks all, ping me if anything blocks :pray:
